lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like geometric pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertically-oriented linear mark or indentation is present on the mid-lateral flank, specifically indicated by the overlaid white graphical arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: Five prominent vertical dark-intensity gill slits are visible on the anterior flank; high-contrast web-like light caustics from the water surface are overlaid across the lower flank and pectoral fin base.
